name: Scapular Pull-Up
instructions: Take a pronated grip on a pull-up bar.
From a hanging position, raise yourself a few inches without using your arms. Do this by depressing your shoulder girdle in a reverse shrugging motion.
Pause at the completion of the movement, and then slowly return to the starting position before performing more repetitions.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: A beginner minimal-equipment pull-pattern exercise for the upper back. Scapular Pull-Up strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
